description.value: Mill Farm Regional Park Reserve is a nature reserve managed by the Capital Regional District near Duncan on southern Vancouver Island. It protects a rural landscape within the CRD's regional parks network, offering visitors a chance to experience natural habitat close to the Cowichan Valley. Touring cyclists in the area may find it a worthwhile natural detour, though specific on-site facilities have not been confirmed.
